entries.rawContent:
Upgrade bonuses given by ouroperks. These bonuses are applied to ALL characters. Use $shoprefund to refund spheres. Type **$oo** for fragments.
Each bonus has 10 levels (cost increased by **+4,000** per level).
You have **15,660** <:sp:1437140700604137554>
[**LVL 5**]  A part of the spawn chance bonus applied by **perk 1** is also applied to the character upgraded. Part: 50% > **60%**
​
[**LVL 5**]  A megasphere has 1/50 to appear when you roll any of your claimed characters. 1 megasphere per day (increased with **perk 2**, see $s megasphere). Number of rewards per megasphere: 15 > **18**
​
[**LVL 0**]  The additional kakera button spawned by **perk 3** has a chance to never include blue kakera (or yellow if Sapphire IV): 0% > **10%**
​
[**LVL 5**]  When you get a key thanks to **perk 4**, there is a chance to get an Omega key. These keys can be added to any character of your collection (see $ok). Chance: 25% > **30%**
​
[**MAX**]  When a kakera button gives spheres thanks to **perk 5**, there is a slight chance to get +1 $ot. Chance for each sphere earned (multiplied by the number of spheres given by the perk 5 level, the value displayed with $op): **0.14%**
[**LVL 5**]  The wish spawned from **perk 6** has a chance to be an unclaimed wish from your wishlist if there is any. This claim is **free** and indicated with a green background (limited to one time per day). Chance: 5% > **6%**
Claimed wishes that you own spawned from perk 6 have a chance to give +1 Omega key: 250% > **300%**
​
[**LVL 0**]  All chaos kakera spawned by **perk 7** have a chance to give double rewards (except for special character spawns and discount), indicated with a blue background: 0% > **2%**
​
[**LVL 6**]  On characters fully upgraded, the kakera buttons of **perk 8** give more kakera. Boost (additive with $bk): 30% > **35%**
​
[**MAX**]  More sphere buttons spawned by **perk 9** can be clicked per day: **+10**
Spheres clicked from **perk 9** give more spheres: **100% **
​
[**LVL 8**]  The first $oh of the day has a chance to give 1 $ot for each character you have fully upgraded (120 characters max): +2% > **+2.25%**
